memory: I believe that leadership in finance is about creating a culture of excellence while maintaining humanity. As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of overseeing a team of 180 professionals across our investment, research, and operations divisions. My leadership philosophy is built on three core pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. By empowering our team members to take ownership and make decisions, holding them accountable for their actions, and fostering a culture of ongoing learning and development, I believe we can achieve greatness. I also believe that the best ideas often come from unexpected places, so I maintain an open-door policy and encourage even our most junior analysts to challenge conventional thinking. By doing so, we can stay ahead of the curve and identify opportunities that others may miss. Every Monday, I host a 'strategic roundtable' where team members from all levels can present their investment theses or operational improvements. It's amazing to see the innovative ideas that emerge from these discussions. Last month, a second-year analyst proposed a novel approach to ESG scoring that we're now implementing across our portfolio. This is just one example of how leadership is not about having all the answers, but about creating an environment where great ideas can flourish.
